subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should maintainers require live/redacted owner-session delivery proof before merge, or explicitly accept source and CI proof for this session-routing change?
rationale: The patch changes message/session delivery behavior for an external PR; repository policy requires real behavior proof, but maintainers can intentionally override that proof gate.

options.title: Require live owner-session proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Telegram Desktop proof, gateway logs, terminal output, or a linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept source-only risk
options.body: Merge based on source and regression-test evidence while owning the risk that real transport/session delivery still misroutes or drops a completion.

recommendation.title: Require live owner-session proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Telegram Desktop proof, gateway logs, terminal output, or a linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest nearby history is in task/subagent completion delivery and required-completion behavior.
